viewer.description: Shared person key. Defaults to the first declared person, or the neutral workspace viewer.

role.description: Native demo role. Shared people default to basic; administrator access must be selected explicitly.

settings.description: Onyx workspace settings overriding neutral defaults and the active edition.

fixtures.description: Explicit Onyx API seed DTOs for specialized existing screens. This is the ordinary fixture response format, not a route-patch language. Shared connector and document snapshots are projected by the adapter.

llm_providers.description: LLM providers keyed by stable name (area: llm). Derives GET /llm/provider, GET /admin/llm/provider, GET /llm/persona/:id/providers and the v5 routing/cost routes. Absent keeps the neutral base fixtures; {} or null means no providers. Merging never deletes: a world layered over another drops an inherited provider with `<key>: null`, or the whole section with `llm_providers: null`.

connectors.description: Connector rows keyed by shared source key (area: conn). Adapter derivation: pending.

cc_pairs.description: Connector/credential pair state keyed by shared source key (area: conn): the pair's status, access, document count and when it was created. With index_runs it drives the cc-pair detail, the indexing status page row (status bucket, latest attempt, queue position) and the old indexing-status rows (adapter/index-runs.mjs). A source with neither keeps the neutral indexed summary.

index_runs.description: Index attempts per shared source key, newest first (area: conn). Derives the pair's runs feed, index attempts, the fleet runs feed, per-attempt stage metrics, and (per request, handlers-index-monitoring.mjs) the throughput charts and the overview.

plugins.description: Unified Plugins entries keyed by stable name (area: plug). Adapter derivation: pending.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers keyed by stable name, with tool snapshots and per-user preferences (area: plug). Adapter derivation: pending.

craft.description: Craft state: sessions, outputs, approvals, action policies, tasks, skills, apps (area: craft). Adapter derivation: pending.

tier.description: Product tier the workspace reports in /settings.tier; Craft demos choose Business explicitly. Adapter derivation: pending.

state.description: World state flags the handlers read per request (written to state.json). One strict area per behavior switch; replaces the per-demo GET /mockshop/* switch fixtures.

llm_provider.description: One LLM provider (null drops an inherited one). Sparse: only `provider` is required.

id.description: Explicit provider ID; otherwise stable from the key.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the provider's label.

provider.description: Onyx provider id: openai, anthropic, azure, bedrock, vertex_ai, portkey, ollama_chat, litellm_proxy, ...

provider_display_name.description: Label in the public catalog; defaults to the known label of `provider`.

default.description: The default provider: its default model also answers the vision and chat-naming defaults unless a model names those purposes.

api_key.description: Masked key text shown in the admin form; overrides api_key_set.

public.description: Defaults to true when neither groups nor agents restrict the provider.

groups.description: Team keys the provider is restricted to; [] = public.

agents.description: Agent keys the provider is restricted to (drives /llm/persona/:id/providers).

models.description: Model configurations keyed by stable name; the key is the model name unless `name` is given.

id.description: Explicit model-configuration ID; otherwise stable from <provider key>/<model key>.

name.description: Model name sent to the provider; defaults to the key.

default.description: true = the default text model; a list names the purposes this model is the default for.

supports_reasoning.description: Defaults to true when reasoning_efforts is non-empty.

vendor.description: Defaults to the provider for openai and anthropic.

router_models.description: Model keys of this provider that Auto mode may route to (GET /admin/llm/router-models).

model.description: Model key of this provider used as the routing model.

cost_overrides.description: Rows of GET /admin/cost-overrides, keyed by any stable name.

id.description: The pair id; same as apps.onyx.sources.<key>.id when both are set.

docs_indexed.description: Documents in the index. Default: the running first attempt's new documents, else the world's documents of the source.

created.description: How long ago the connector and its account were created, such as 50m; default 120d. Sets the overall indexing speed.
Durations before the demo clock, such as 45m or 2h30m. created defaults to started; a queued run has only created.

updated.description: A running run's last update; default 1m. Sets its docs/min.

finished.description: Required for a finished run, absent for a queued or running one.

total_docs.description: New plus updated documents; default new_docs.

from_beginning.description: Default true for the oldest listed run only.

resolved.description: When an admin resolved the run.

batches.description: Batches processed so far; required with stages.

stages.description: IndexAttemptStage -> seconds per batch, or {avg, min?, max?, sd?} in seconds. BATCH_TOTAL and BATCH_UNACCOUNTED are derived; fetch and docprocessing totals must fit in the run's span.

server.description: mcp_servers key when kind is mcp.

connection_status.description: What the Plugins page shows to members; defaults to connected (Ready to use).

default_chat_enabled.description: Admin default for Main Chat; defaults to true.

user_enabled_in_chat.description: The viewer's own chat toggle; defaults to true.

user_enabled_in_craft.description: The viewer's own Craft toggle; defaults to false.

case.description: Cloud billing case: picks the billing snapshot and settings.tier.

options.description: Per-demo user-extras overlay over the seed; `enabled: true` switches the extras on.

content.description: Replaces the seeded auth-anonymous content wholesale.

browser.description: Web storage the runner seeds into the page origin at context creation (a list, so keys may use {{refs}}).

cites.description: Ordered citations: world document keys, or URLs of this reply's web_search results / open_url pages.

turn.description: Exact prepared turn identity for an authored native submission armed by state.turn; excluded from manual regex selection.

question.description: Exact native submitted question for the prepared turn guard.

web_search.description: true marks the internal search step as an internet search (older flag). An object stages a separate native web search step.

open_url.description: Pages read by a native Open URL step.

code.description: A native code interpreter (Python) step: code, output, error and generated files.

chat_file.description: A file the code step generated, linked from the answer as [name](name). Exactly one of body, rows or path.

body.description: Text content (body_file loads it from a relative file).

rows.description: CSV/TSV rows; the first row is the header.

path.description: Binary or text file relative to the declaring YAML file, for example an authored PNG chart.

parsed_preview.description: xlsx only: what GET /chat/file/<id>?parsed=true returns so the in-app spreadsheet preview renders values (not formulas).
